title: The Compass of the Coral Triangle
author: Cyrus Almeida
blurb: Elodie Okonkwo, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
